digest.component_or_area: reconciler field-symmetry registry and property tests
propositions: Reconciler field asymmetry policies (bidirectional-roundtrip, add-wins, one-way-with-propagation-gate) are scattered across multiple call sites with no single declarative registry, allowing parity bugs to escape undetected

A new declarative field-contract registry must enumerate all reconciled fields with their symmetry class and code references, guarded by property tests that fail if a handled field lacks a registry entry
Property tests must assert roundtrip identity for declared-bidirectional codecs, merge-idempotence for add-wins fields, and gate-consultation behavior for one-way-gated fields through real code paths
The registration contract must be documented in architecture.md to establish convention for future field declarations and prevent drift recurrence
